topic: Round 1 Re-Review: Deep Architectural & Performance Audit for v1.0.0 Dev Preview Release

invariant_5_compressed_default_surface.evidence: 2-tier Role + Harness user model. Deduplicated 71% of instruction redundancy into AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md (R9). Fast-track 3-5 stage GOVERNS.

decision_text: Decision: Synlynk v1.0.0 Developer Preview is ARCHITECTURALLY CLEARED FOR RELEASE.
